datasets.title: Geodata of Damage Assessment of Hansapur Area, Western Region, Nepal
datasets.description: This map illustrates satellite-detected damage and destruction in the Hansapur area of Nepal. Located roughly seven and a half to twelve kilometers west of the 25 April 2015 earthquake epicenter, the Hansapur area was significantly impacted by this event. Using satellite imagery acquired 29 April 2015 UNITAR / UNOSAT identified a total of 145 affected structures in this area. Approximately 33 of these were destroyed, 47 severely damaged, and 65 moderately damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR / UNOSAT.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-damage-assessment-of-hansapur-area-western-region-nepal-may-05-2015]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts compared satellite imagery acquired 29 April 2015 with pre-event imagery to detect structural damage in the Hansapur area, 7.5-12 km west of the earthquake epicenter. Buildings were classified into three damage categories (destroyed, severely damaged, moderately damaged) through visual interpretation of satellite-detected changes. This preliminary assessment was not field-validated.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis comparing pre- and post-event images acquired 29 April 2015 to identify and classify building damage from the 25 April 2015 earthquake
